review.rationale: Coordinator source-grant review on 2026-11-16 retains the exact Design493 AGPL grant. Real H-22 PostgreSQL reproduced that an existing UNKNOWN could not settle after protocol revocation. Permit only its definite final observation under the current hub with original identity/owner/digest/channel and unchanged delivery count. Increased delivery count or channel change still requires active protocol even when state remains UNKNOWN. New admission, final-result immutability and all current-hub checks remain. Used r1/r2/r3 are immutable; final independent implementation review remains required.
